arxiv:2609.29429.title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
arxiv:2609.29429.reading_depth: Full-text relevant sections including hallucination, calibration, context availability and limitations
findings: Typed decisions can be used for hallucination monitoring with source context
Detector ranking and deployed threshold/calibration require separate evaluation
Gains involving label-defining context must not be treated as deployable evidence
limits: One RLCD model, mostly English scorer-labelled benchmarks

arxiv:2609.37647.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev
arxiv:2609.37647.reading_depth: Abstract and full-text opening/method summary; not a complete paper replication
findings: Classification/NLI is relevant to relation adjudication
Choice and binary probability behaviour differ
Thresholds tuned on separate development data can improve binary decisions
limits: Public benchmark calibration need not transfer to HaluMem
